Galacto is a cozy idle game you keep at the bottom of your screen. Ships pull in for fuel, bots do the work, and you collect the money, slowly turning one working pump into the busiest gas station in the galaxy!

A ship docks. A bot walks over and starts the pump. When it's done, you click to get paid. That's the whole loop, and it's weirdly hard to stop doing. It plays itself while you're busy. It pays out when you're not.

Buy more pumps. Hire more bots to run them. Upgrade your pumps and gear at Tony's Garage so every ship pays out more. The whole place gets busier, louder, and more alive with every credit you sink into it.

Hit one button and the whole game folds into a tiny icon you can park anywhere on your screen. It keeps running underneath, ships refuel, creds stack up, nothing pauses. Click the icon and it slides right back.

Collect ships fast enough and they chain into a combo. Since ships never leave and money never expires, a row of them sitting there isn't a backlog, it's a combo waiting to happen. Step away, let them stack up, then come back and clear the whole line in one window. Stepping away isn't punished here. It's how you set up the big one.

Play in Your Language

Galacto ships in 12 languages, so it feels at home wherever your desktop is.

Galaxiwilds is a narrative-driven space exploration experience focused on discovery, first contact, and uncovering the unknown.

Reality is breaking.

Across multiple universes, rifts tear through space, black holes behave unpredictably, and entire systems collapse without warning. These phenomena are not random—they are connected.

Your mission is not to conquer.
It is to understand.

Travel between universes, chart strange systems, and make contact with 75 unique alien civilizations, each with their own culture, history, technology, and perspective on the unfolding crisis.

Some will share knowledge.
Some will grant you new abilities.
Some will offer allies you can call upon—individuals with their own personalities, insights, and stories to tell.

As your network grows, so does your understanding of what lies beyond the rifts… and what may be causing them.

But this is not a guided journey.

Clues are not handed to you. Coordinates are not saved. Information must be observed, remembered, and recorded.

The truth is out there—but only if you’re paying attention.

Leveraging 25 years of "iHorse Racing" development expertise, "Gallop Diva" is a visual novel that combines realistic horse physics with deep narrative simulation.

  • On the surface the prestigious girls’ horse racing academy is a cradle for elite jockeys.
    Elegant uniforms, magnificent racecourses, high-profile competitions, with young riders surrounded by thunderous applause.

    But once you step onto the track, you will soon realize that this place was never simply about chasing dreams.

    A student’s worth is decided by victory.
    A jockey’s future is decided by investors.
    And the power of the academy lies in the hands of the gifted young riders who can bring it prize money, fame, and profit.

    Every race is a gamble.
    Every conversation may be a trap.
    Every helping hand may hide another intention.

    In this twisted yet dazzling horse racing academy, you will meet a group of young female riders filled with talent, ambition, and secrets. Some are arrogant, some are calm, some are innocent, some are dangerous, and some are simply waiting for a chance to change their fate.

    On a racetrack where speed and lies intertwine, who can you truly trust?
    And can you break free from the rules this academy has already written for you, while everyone is watching?

Game Features

A Story-Driven Experience Set in a Girls’ Horse Racing Academy

  • The story takes place in a prestigious horse racing academy that trains elite jockeys.
    Here, you will find not only youth, competition, and friendship, but also ranking systems, factional conflicts, pressure from investors, and a cruel reality where everything is controlled by the winners.

Horse Racing Scenes Full of Speed and Pressure

  • A race is not just a result. It is part of the story.
    Every start, chase, overtake, and mistake may become a turning point in a character’s fate.

Real Races and Horses

  • In addition to the original characters created for the story, the races, horses, and even jockeys that appear in the game are based on real-world data.
    If you are familiar with horse racing, you will find many details that feel instantly recognizable.

Distinctive Young Female Riders

  • An arrogant heiress, a calm guardian of the rules, a willful genius, a mysterious masked rider...
    Each character has her own beliefs, weaknesses, and secrets. Your relationship with them will influence the direction of the story and the truth behind the races.

A Story Where Horse Racing, Power, and Human Desires Intertwine

  • This is not a simple racing story.
    Here, victory means resources. Popularity means value. And failure may cost someone everything.

    What you must face is not only the speed of your rivals’ horses, but also the families, money, student organizations, and dark rules behind them.

Gambit Gardens is a game about being a cute, yet ruthless real estate mogul! <3

Your aim? Build the best plant empire you can by winning blind auctions to place powerful plants!

But watch out for your scheming opponents, who are willing to do anything to become the ruler of the garden!

You start out with a set hand of plants with one strategy-defining plant, and have to utilize it to its fullest—but enemies have their own tricks too, so watch out!

Campaign Mode is our bite-sized roguelike mode, where you start with a top secret you choose and play against 5 increasingly difficult rounds of opponents with shops to upgrade your plants (and maybe see some rare shiny plants) in between.

Money you use for bidding carries over between stages, so spend wisely!

One Wallet. Four Hunters. Zero Trust.

Gamble Hunters is a casino action roguelite for solo players or up to 4 Steam friends.

Become an adorable space pirate, hunt monsters for 60 seconds, and take the Rupees you earn to the casino.

The catch? Rupees belong to everyone. The Gold you win is yours alone.

Cash in your share before your friends blow it all.

Hunt Together. Jackpot's Mine. Debt's Ours.

In multiplayer, every Rupee from the hunt goes into one shared wallet.

The Gold you win at the casino is yours to keep, but the debt belongs to the whole crew.

The thinner the wallet, the faster your pulse.

Get your spin in before your friends do, and feel free to nudge them off the slot machine while you're at it.

Voice chat is for strategy. Probably.

"Hey! That was OUR money!"

Kills Don't Pay. Cash Does.

Ride your ship, mow down waves of monsters, and enjoy the thrill of nonstop automatic fire.

When the 60 seconds are up, rank rewards go to whoever earned the most Rupees.

Even when everyone's firing away, whoever spots a hidden prize like the Golden Anglerfish first can snatch the top spot.

Same Pot. Bigger Spoon.

Bet the shared Rupees on slots, roulette, blackjack, baccarat, Sic Bo, Peg Drop and more, and win Gold for yourself.

There's no time to overthink a single hand. The fastest hands take home the most.

Run several games at once and keep the bets flowing.

Raise your bet size as you grow, and you'll scoop more out of the same wallet than anyone else.

Of course, the money might not come back. Better have an excuse ready for your friends.

Bigger Gun. Same Debt.

Spend your Gold to upgrade weapons, and combine skill traits to shape your own playstyle.

Stack artifacts that affect both combat and the casino to craft a unique build for every run.

But pour everything into upgrades and you'll miss the repayment deadline.

Power up your gun, or pay down everyone's debt?

To get past tougher monsters and bosses, you can't neglect any of it: hunting, betting, upgrading, repaying.

And remember: if you can't repay and go bankrupt, the run is over.

What's Waiting in Gamble Hunters

Solo play or co-op for up to 4 players

Steam friend invites, lobbies and voice chat

Shared Rupees, personal Gold, shared debt

60 seconds of first-person shooting with no reloads

Rank rewards decided by earnings, plus hidden monsters

Casino games, machine guns and skill traits to unlock

Artifacts that affect combat and the casino, plus in-game Special Offers that grant random artifacts

Replayable runs against tougher enemies and bosses

Adorable space pirates and character cosmetics

Ready to out-earn your friends?

Add it to your wishlist and get ready for your First Hunt!

Note: This game is not real gambling and never asks for any additional purchases. All bets are made with in-game virtual currency only. There is no real-money gambling and no rewards with cash value.

At a Glance

  • A full career from 1995 to 2019, across four hardware generations

  • 27 genres, 42 topics, and 23 platforms that rise and fall

  • Three audiences and four world regions that buy differently

  • 100 rival studios with their own release histories

  • Your own game engine, built tech by tech

  • Genre Awards, Game of the Year, and a world ranking to top

Make Games Your Way

Start in 1995 with one developer and a small office. Develop your first game by choosing its genre, topic, platform, and features, and design its cover.

There's no recipe that always makes a hit. Follow your own idea, aim for a big crowd, or turn a surprise success into a series.

Compete With Rival Studios

Other studios are making games at the same time. They have their own games and audience: casual, mainstream or hardcore. Watch them climb the world ranking and try to pass them.

Keep an eye on what rival studios are making. Launch at the right time, beat the game at the top of the charts, or take back a genre from the studio that passed you.

Build Your Studio

Hire a team, upgrade their computers, and solve problems during development. Move into bigger offices and build your own game engine as the studio grows.

  • Real people. Every developer has their own skills, traits, and stress. Overwork leads to burnout.

  • Keep your best people. Rival studios make poach offers, and unhappy staff threaten to quit.

  • Stories with choices. Events during and between projects ask you to decide what the studio does.

  • Your own engine. Research tech on the engine map and manage technical debt. Each new generation, choose whether to upgrade the engine or build a new one, or license an engine instead.

  • Prestige. Climb from Unknown to Icon. Higher prestige brings publisher offers, review copies, and questions about what kind of studio you want to be.

By 2020, look back at a catalog full of flops, hits, long-running series, and games that became the top sellers in their genres. Can you make the year's best game and reach world rank #1?

Discover Your Gaming DNA

Fast reactions. Steady aim. A memory that holds up under pressure. Which is your strongest skill?

Gaming DNA & ESTI brings together short, replayable challenges. Test yourself, check your results, and go again to beat your personal best.

Short Tests. One More Try.

  • React to visual and audio signals.
  • Find targets and track moving objects.
  • Remember numbers, positions, and sequences.
  • Read colors and shapes under time pressure.

Keep Moving

Dodge incoming skills in classic 2D MOBA training. Read the danger, time your movement, and find a way through.

Inside the Demo Build

13 skill-test modes plus classic 2D MOBA dodge training. The Windows Demo interface is available in 12 languages.

Thank you for your interest in our game! We are a tiny indie 2-man studio working on our dream!

GANK brings a unique flavor to the 5v5 MOBA genre - you control all 5 heroes on the team in a tabletop boardgame format! Instead of point-and-click in real time, players take turns picking cards that represent the usual actions you take in a match; Farming neutral camps for Gold, attacking other Champions, finding treasures that spawn at intervals, pushing the actual lanes; It's all turn-based!

The game was meticulously designed across more than 5 years and started since 2019 as seen on the boardgame scene on various websites. Over thousands of logged games eventually got the game to this point.

We realize there are 2 groups - the competitive hardcore, and the casual. For the hardcore, you can expect the same cut-throat mode of winning half the battle even before the match starts... by drafting and banning Champions correctly. Hard-countering is alive in this game! But wait, what about those who just started with little info on Champions' skills? Or the more relaxed group who just want to enjoy using their favorite group of Champions? We have a different system for casuals and it has ZERO penalty, with a focus on just having fun.

Here's what Gank features:

  • Heavy world-building around high-fantasy Eudoria, filled with lots of interesting characters

  • Huge investments in REAL top artists from famous works like Star Wars and Magic

  • Several original tracks featuring across popular themes like vikings or even pirates

  • Original take on turn-based system in the MOBA genre

  • Hardcore drafting league for advanced players looking for a true challenge

  • Separate casual friendly matches with no penalty

  • Practice or play full matches against AI bots

  • Champions can level up and unlock their 'Ultimate' skill in matches

  • Farm materials to shop and craft legendary equipment that can turn the tide

  • Unique victory condition where players can do set collection and gather enough Krystals to destroy the enemy base instantly, making comebacks very real and keeping anyone on their toes until the very end of a match

  • Full bonus solo campaign with roguelite style, complete with permanent upgrades

  • Campaign also has its own set of uniquely designed enemies

  • Each Champion has its own lore and ending in the campaign, bringing huge replay value

  • Drawn and designed by top talented artists who drew for Fantasy Flight, Star Wars, Dungeons & Dragons, Magic The Gathering!

Ever wanted to see what happens when a Monk goes up against a Deathknight? Or a Pirate against a Pugilist? All the mainstream folks are here for the showdown! But because of that, there are a lot of skills and abilities in Gank. Taking on the game as a first timer could overwhelm you! Enjoy the learning process and know that at any point you can always reference both your Champions' skills as well as your opponents' by clicking on either side of the screen!

Every Map Has a Code

Build a map. Share it. Play it.

In GATESHOCK, every map you create in the editor — paths, water, obstacles, buildable ground and all — becomes a single shareable code.

Paste that code into chat and someone else can play the exact same map. Same paths, same water, same build spots — so when they tell you which wave they reached, you know exactly what you have to beat.

That’s the part no other tower defense does quite like GATESHOCK.

Which is why there’s no traditional level pack. There’s an editor.

Try the demo

The first eight campaign missions on two planets, seven towers, and the full map editor with share codes. Build a map, send the code, see who holds longer. The rest — eight more missions, seven more towers, RUNS and ENDLESS — waits in the full game.

Three Ways to Play

CAMPAIGN

16 handcrafted missions across four planets.

Every mission introduces a tower, enemy, or mechanic — and asks one question:

Which tower solves this map?

You have five lives. If a boss gets through, the mission is over.

RUNS

Four acts. A branching map. One run.

Choose your path through shops, events, elite fights, and 40 relics that can completely change how you play.

More lives for less damage.

Cheaper towers for slower income.

Builds that force you to rethink everything.

Lives carry across the entire run. Lose them all, and the run is over.

ENDLESS

One map. Endless waves.

Pick your planet and biome, build the strongest setup you can, and chase one thing:

Your own record.

14 Towers. Zero Filler.

Every tower has four upgrade tiers and its own skill tree, including Master Keystones that fundamentally change how the tower behaves — not just how much damage it deals.

The Ray heats up while holding a target and burns through armor.

The Boombox buffs nearby towers.

The Outpost creates new buildable ground. It doesn’t use a tower slot — because creating more space to build is its entire job.

And then there’s armor.

Armor absorbs a fixed amount from every hit, making heavy single shots incredibly valuable against tough targets while rapid-fire weapons can struggle to make a dent.

Bringing more of the same gun is rarely the answer.

Orbital Support

Your ship has more to offer than moral support.

Unlock 10 orbital abilities through officer ranks and build them in the hangar:

  • Kinetic strikes

  • Chain lightning

  • An orbital laser that crawls along the lane

  • Gravity wells

  • Supply platforms that create new buildable ground mid-wave

You only get three ability slots.

Choosing what to bring means choosing what to leave behind.

Your Commander Talks Back

Admiral Peaches is fully voiced — and she has opinions about your build.

English voice-over, with interface and subtitles in English and German.

What You're Fighting

The enemy roster is designed to punish predictable builds:

  • Fast-moving swarms

  • Armored units that shrug off small arms

  • Phased enemies that temporarily become untouchable

  • Splitters that turn one problem into several

  • Bosses that drop loot worth the trouble

You’ll need more than one good tower to deal with all of them.

The Details

  • Hex grid: 14×12, pointy-top

  • 14 towers, each with four upgrade tiers and a unique skill tree

  • 10 orbital abilities

  • 40 relics for Runs

  • 16 handcrafted Campaign missions

  • Endless mode with planet and biome selection

  • Map editor with shareable map codes

  • Procedurally generated maps

  • Meta progression across every mode: ranks, materials, and socket items

  • Windows 10/11 (64-bit)

  • 4 GB RAM minimum

Build it. Share it. Break the meta.

GemSlasher is an action roguelite where every attack is built from gems.

Combine Main Gems with Support Gems, merge duplicate gems to increase their star level, and create powerful builds capable of tearing through relentless waves of monsters.

BUILD YOUR OWN GEM COMBINATIONS

Each Main Gem determines how you attack, while Support Gems modify how that attack works.

Increase attack speed, boost damage, add projectiles, unleash repeated strikes, inflict bleeding, and discover combinations that can completely transform the way you fight.

Equip multiple Main Gems and combine powerful manually activated attacks with skills that trigger automatically.

MERGE, UPGRADE, AND ADAPT

Collect duplicate gems and merge them to increase their star level.

With every reward, shop visit, and upgrade choice, you can strengthen your current build—or take it in a completely different direction before the next battle.

Experiment with different gem combinations and discover new ways to build your character with each run.

SURVIVE ESCALATING WAVES

Fight through increasingly dangerous waves, using rewards and shops between battles to strengthen your build.

As the run progresses, enemies become more numerous and more dangerous, forcing you to continually refine your gem setup and make the most of every upgrade.

CREATE DEVASTATING BUILDS

Combine gems to create rapid melee attacks, projectile-heavy setups, bleeding-focused builds, repeated strikes, and other powerful synergies.

Experiment with different characters and gem combinations to find the playstyle that suits you best.

KEY FEATURES

• Fast-paced hack-and-slash combat

• Main Gem and Support Gem combination system

• Gem merging and star-level progression

• Manually activated and automatic skills

• Randomized rewards and shop inventories

• Multiple playable characters

• Escalating waves and boss battles

• Single-player roguelite gameplay

DODGE. EVOLVE. SURVIVE.

Gemfire Survival is a minimalist, high-octane action roguelike where your only objective is to survive the neon grid. Pilot your core through endless, escalating waves of geometric enemies, dodging incoming fire while your auto-blaster clears the path. Collect the emerald gems left behind by shattered enemies to level up, stack temporary upgrades, and create unstoppable, screen-clearing builds.

MASTER THE 60-SECOND CYCLE

The grid doesn't give you time to breathe. Every 60 seconds, a massive Boss—like the devastating Nova Barrage—spawns into the arena. You must balance clearing out the smaller swarmers with dealing focused damage to the boss before you get overwhelmed.

INFINITE META-PROGRESSION

Death is just a currency. Every gem you bank during a run is yours to keep. Head to the Neon Skill Tree between runs to spend your banked gems on permanent upgrades. Want to start with a faster fire rate, magnetic gem pickup, or reactive armor? You can. Best of all: every branch can grow forever. There are no level caps on your permanent progression.

CORE FEATURES

  • Deep Synergies: Combine dozens of Common and Rare upgrades during your run, from Phase Skates to Orbital Shields and Focus Lenses.

  • Uncapped Upgrades: Spend banked gems in the Neon Skill Tree on stats that scale infinitely.

  • Relentless Bosses: Face a new, escalating threat every single minute.

  • Hard Mode: Ready for a true challenge? Toggle Hard Mode for faster spawns, tougher enemies, and higher scores.

  • Arcade Aesthetics: Crisp neon visuals, satisfying particle explosions, and a pulsing synthwave soundtrack to keep you in the flow state.

One Man's Life Is the Modern History of a Nation

1930. Born into a poor peasant family under colonial rule; his childhood spent in a thatched hut.
He fled with his family into exile — working the fields, the factory floor, a newspaper route. Later he passed into the Military Academy, put on the uniform, and walked, through war and coup, into the corridors of power.
1961. Amid the gunfire of a coup, he chose his side.
1979. In the vacuum left by an assassinated president, he stood at history's crossroads.
The 1980s. He rose to the highest office. 1995. He stood before the judgment of history.

This man is Jeon Du-heo.

General Jeon is a visual novel × turn-based life-raising game set against the backdrop of modern Korean history.

You play as Jeon Du-heo, starting from nothing and spending a limited pool of action points to shape an entire life. Study, train, make friends, amass wealth, gamble, brawl — from back-alley streets to the Academy parade ground, from army factions to the seat of power. Across nearly sixty years you accumulate ability, money and connections, and face one choice after another that could change everything.

You may walk the path history recorded — or see your life cut short by a failed exam, an unexpected clash, or a single wrong allegiance.

History has one answer. Your fate does not.

Homines possunt historiam condonare, sed deus non vult.

Core Gameplay

📋 01 | Turn-Based Life Raising: A life decided by limited actions

You get one life, and every turn forces a trade-off.

With a limited pool of Action Points (AP), you chart your own course through dozens of life events — studying, training, socializing, part-time work, scheming.

Growth runs on three axes — personal attributes × money and power × relationships — and what “growing up” means shifts with every stage of life.

In your youth you build Intelligence, Physique, Command, Wealth and Dream. At the Academy those early gains convert into Might, Cunning and Ambition. And inside the halls of power, what decides your future becomes command ability, accumulated wealth, and the favor of the man on top.

A book read today, a friend made today — either may become the bargaining chip that decides your fate decades later.

⚖️ 02 | Choices That Decide: History remembers the outcome; you remember the choice

Fail the Academy exam and you may be shipped to the front. Lose a street fight and your life may end early. Bet on the wrong horse in a power struggle and years of work can vanish.

Your abilities, your relationships, your past — all of them can weigh on the outcome of a critical moment.

Not every effort is rewarded. Not every defeat can be undone.

Sometimes the protagonist exits quietly before the story even begins.

🤝 03 | Bonds and Loyalties: From boyhood friendships to power games

A wife you married young. Brothers-in-arms. Political allies. Trusted confidants. Build bonds with dozens of characters drawn from real historical figures.

A friendship from your teens can last decades. An ordinary encounter can become the setup for a turn of fate years later.

You can befriend, court, distance yourself — or betray. When private feeling collides with hard interest, and an old friend stands on the other side, what will you choose?

🎲 04 | Games Within the Game: Every era has its own contest

Dice on the casino table. A drinking contest over the cups. The save that decides the match. A brawl ready to ignite on any street corner.

As each stage of life opens up, you'll meet mini-games and special events woven into their historical moment.

And as you close in on the seat of power, the board itself changes.

Problems once settled with fists and drink become troop movements, factional maneuvering, and political gambits.

🗺️ 05 | Multiple Endings: History has one answer — your life may not

History had a set ending: a death sentence, commuted to life, then a pardon.

In General Jeon, you may never reach that day.

Flunking out of the Academy. A failed coup. An invasion. A quiet discharge. A courtroom. What you have built and what you chose will carry you to a different end.

On the historical spine you live through events drawn from real history. On the alternate branches, one failed check, one unexpected clash, one different choice can redirect the rest of a life.

One starting point. Utterly different destinations.

🕯️ Core Narrative | History recorded what he chose. You answer why.

History can record what a man said and did. It cannot show you his heart.

In General Jeon's historical mainline, key events follow the course they actually took. You, in first person, interpret what moved him at each stage of his life.

At one turning point after another, the same question returns:

“Why did he do it?”

Sincere, or feigned?
Principle, or opportunism?
Forced by circumstance, or planned all along?

Your answer won't rewrite what happened. It will change how he understands his own choices — and what the same memory comes to mean in the years that follow.

A sentence once spoken in earnest can, years later, become a chip in a trade. A friendship you once thought little of can take on an entirely different weight because of what you chose back then.

You'll look back over the life you lived — and see how choices that once seemed trivial shaped the man standing in front of you.

History recorded what he did. You answer why he did it.

A Modern Korean History You Can Live Through

Set against modern Korean history, the game folds war, overseas deployment, an assassinated president, a military coup, the wave of democratization, and a judicial reckoning into the arc of one man's life.

Written by a PhD in East Asian history, the script braids historical research with alternate narrative, following different characters' circumstances and choices to show what an era does to a life.

Beyond the serious history there are period details and hidden events to find — we look forward to seeing what you uncover.

So don't look so grim. Let's go have a drink in Gungseong-dong.

“Just say it’s genuine. Forty crowns, after the seal.”


Vienna, 1901. You have inherited your uncle’s bureau — the place people bring old things to when they need to know whether they are real. With it come his loupe, his books, his seal, and his debt: 150 crowns in seven days. An honest verdict pays three crowns. The man across the desk is offering forty.

The bureau will not help you


There is no hint button. Nothing glows. Nobody tells you that you are close. You are shown the object and everything on it, and after that you are on your own — and it is your name at the bottom.

That is what makes it hard. Not that something is hidden from you — the mark is right there under the loupe. It is that the thing looks real, reads real, and isn’t, and the only person answerable for the difference is you.

Everything you write must be something you saw with your own eyes: the mark under the loupe, the streak the metal left on the stone, the line in the book. If you didn’t see it, you can’t write it.

Then comes the seal: hot wax on the paper, and the press down on top of it. The wax hardens in a second and nothing can be rewritten. Three seals over a lie and the bureau closes for good.

Seven days is not a long week. Most people never see the seventh day: the bureau shuts before the week runs out. Honestly, you probably won’t finish this game. Prove us wrong.

Seven days, each one harder than the last


On the first day the lie is easy to see: copper coming through where the silver has worn away.

After that it hides. Put the thing on the scales against a weight you trust and the beam tips the wrong way. Lower it into water and the water rises higher than it should: something heavier is sitting under the gilding. Tilt the lamp and the shadow drops into a dent where somebody ground a hallmark off. Breathe on cold metal and the mist clears in a neat square — a patch was soldered in there. Hold a template against the edge and there is a gap, because that curve was made in another century.

And it is not only silver. Papers and documents follow, a canvas restretched onto somebody else’s frame, furniture with a false bottom, a collector’s curiosities — a fossil that arrived from London a year too early to have arrived at all.

By the seventh day you can test a thing six different ways — and whoever is making these forgeries is learning at exactly the same speed you are.

Nothing here is a menu


The bribe is on the desk before you start, and it sits in front of you while you work. Take it, or put it in the stove.

The dealer you can prove is a thief is standing in your office, and the gendarmes are two streets away. Turn him in, or say nothing and keep a client.

Tell a widow the truth and she leaves with nothing, and you have earned your three crowns.

You never pick a line of dialogue from a list. You simply do it — and the bureau’s book remembers what you did.

Four endings. Only one of them is earned


Nothing decides your ending except the papers you signed. Three of them you merely survive into. The fourth has to be won, and it comes down to a single document nobody meant to hand you for examination: your own.

The office is keeping things from you as well


The dust on that shelf is broken in an arc — the box was moved recently. One book’s spine is worn far more than its neighbours. The card index is locked with a code, and the clock in this room stopped at 15:06. Seven hiding places across seven days: you spot one during the day and open it in the evening, once the clients have gone.

Vienna, 1901


Theodor Haas kept this bureau at Wollzeile 17 for thirty years. A city of dealers, moneylenders and workshops, where every piece of silver carries somebody’s mark. A workshop can close in 1869 and its mark still turn up on silver made in 1874. Somebody is putting those marks there.

Nobody killed your uncle. They broke him with paperwork — and they still hold the paper.

Run. Adapt. Push Your Limits.

Enter a synthwave universe where neon lights and futuristic colors set the stage for a challenge built around absolute precision.

In Geometry Run, you control a glowing cube in a 3D third-person platformer where every jump, every landing, and every second can make the difference. The path to the finish line is easy to understand, but difficult to master.

Whether you want to complete every level or chase the perfect time, the challenge remains the same: become faster than your previous run.

Built for Speedrunners

Every level is designed to be replayed dozens of times. Discover shortcuts, perfect your routes, eliminate unnecessary movements, and constantly improve your time.

The mechanics are easy to learn but require precision, memory, and reflexes to master. Every mistake becomes an opportunity to find a more efficient path and transform a good run into a perfect one.

Three Ways to Play Every Level

Each level offers three different variations:

Normal

Experience the original route and learn the obstacles, rhythm, and mechanics.

Reverse

Replay the level in the opposite direction. The entire route changes, and everything you learned must be rethought from scratch.

Time Trial

A mode designed to push your skills to the limit. Faster, more intense, and made for those searching for the perfect run.

A Neon World

Immerse yourself in a synthwave-inspired aesthetic featuring vibrant colors, neon lights, futuristic environments, and an electronic soundtrack that accompanies every moment of your run.

The minimalist style keeps the action clear and focused, allowing you to concentrate on what truly matters: the next jump.

Every run is a new attempt.
Every attempt is a new record to beat.

Skip Meditation. Start Stealing.

Go about your day while your little thief takes shortcuts to immortality, swiping cultivators’ robes, hats, and magical artifacts for cash. The higher he ascends, the more outrageous his heists become.

Build a Shady Empire

Mass-produce knockoffs of stolen treasures, auction off your haul, or put it on display and charge admission. Pour every ill-gotten coin into your cultivation.

Can You Cheat Heaven?

Your shady business keeps growing—until even Heaven takes notice. Can your little thief still steal his way to the top? How will your story end?

Build Your Immune System

Get Outta My Gut is a roguelite tower defense game where you protect your body from invading germs. Defend your heart with turrets, build blood vessels to keep them working, and cut the membrane to start each wave.

Draft Your Defenses

Draft turret cards throughout each run and combine turrets with different roles. Use antibody guns and pill mortars to deal damage, or cells that devour germs to heal the heart.

Cards range from Common to Legendary. Rarer cards offer more mutation branches, giving you more ways to develop each turret. Unlock additional classes and rarities through permanent progression.

Keep the Blood Flowing

Connect your turrets to the heart with blood vessels. Heart health determines the available blood pressure, so protecting the heart also keeps your defenses running. Guard the vessels against parasites that can cut off the supply.

Control the Swarm

Open and repair membrane gates to steer germs toward your turrets. Use narrow passages to bring the swarm into range of several defenses at once.

Mutate Your Turrets

Every turret has its own mutation tree. Upgrade antibody guns with homing shots and mortars with acid pools that linger after each blast. Combine attacking, healing, and support turrets to strengthen your defense.

Evolve Between Runs

Unlock new turrets, strengthen the heart, and improve future drafts through the permanent Evolution tree. These upgrades carry over between runs, even after a defeat.

Fight through 10 organs, each with 100 waves, new threats, elite germs, and bosses. After clearing an organ, return to face stronger germs on higher strain levels.

Key Features

  • 30 turret classes with individual mutation trees.

  • Turret card drafts with 5 rarities, from Common to Legendary.

  • Blood vessels and a pressure supply tied to heart health.

  • Membranes you cut to start waves and gates you open or repair to change routes.

  • 10 organs, with 100 waves in each.

  • Wave events that change enemy stats, elite germs, and bosses.

  • Combos and wave ranks.

  • Permanent upgrades and harder strains for replaying completed organs.

This is an auto-chess game. By combining units' skills, passive abilities, and synergies, units can grow infinitely stronger.

Each unit has 1 passive skill and 2 active skills. The passive skills and synergy effects of different characters form skill trigger chains, creating a 1+1>2 effect. The game also features various equipment and food items that can trigger various effects and synergize with units' passive skills and synergies.

The game has Normal Mode and Roguelike Mode. In Normal Mode, you purchase units from the shop; in Roguelike Mode, you choose 1 unit out of 3. After each clear, you can continue to challenge Endless Mode, facing increasingly stronger enemies. See how many waves you can survive.

Spooky has come to the human world to scare ( or help? ) people!

Spooky, a ghost who carries the high expectations of his parents, has finally turned 10! According to tradition, he is to be sent to the human world to scare people. But he is just way too cute to scare anyone at all.

Instead of scaring people, he found that helping people is fun too.

But little does he know, his kindness is bringing disaster to this town...

Pack up the packages at various shops and deliver them to the apartment building up ahead!

Ghost Express is a puzzle game where players click and drag items one by one into the grid of a box. As time goes on and items keep piling up, figuring out how to arrange them all becomes something you really need to think through.

Game Features:

  • No time limits, so there's no pressure while you play.

  • Cute visuals and music create a cozy atmosphere to play in.

Welcome to Neo Haven

Run your own cyberpunk pawn shop in Neo Haven, where every deal is a gamble and patience is your most valuable resource. Experience tense, high-stakes pawn negotiations: inspect mysterious items, question suspicious sellers, uncover hidden value, and spot counterfeits. Every action costs precious time, forcing you to make tough decisions before it's too late.

At its core, master high-stakes thrilling pawn deals and exploit a constantly shifting economy : Stock your shelves, sell groceries, and outsmart a constantly shifting economy to grow your business. Along the way, uncover hidden stories and secrets in a city where information is worth more than money. Examine items to decide what to buy, with a simple storyline and hidden side details to uncover as you play as an intriguing side venue.

🤝 Negotiate Pawn Deals

Haggle and negotiate prices with customers, earn trust, examine suspicious items, and decide which deals are worth the risk. Some customers have a story to tell and others may have something to hide.

🔍 Examine Every Detail

Some objects deserve a closer look. Rotate, zoom, and inspect suspicious weapons, cyberware, relics, and digital devices to uncover points of interest. A damaged serial number. Fresh marks. Hidden details. Small discoveries can reveal valuable evidence and change what you know about an item. Sometimes the truth is hidden in plain sight.

📦 Run Your Store

Running a successful business starts with everyday work. Order products through a terminal system,wait for delivery,  unpack deliveries, stock shelves, organize inventory and keep your customers supplied. Buy a checkout android or a cleaning bot to help make your shop efficient and tidy.

🕵️ Follow The Clues

Not every mystery begins with a crime scene. Damaged cyberware, encrypted data shards and rare weapons may all be connected. Examine suspicious items, consult local contacts, and piece together the evidence. Once you crack a case, decide what to do with the intel: sell it to rival factions for cold cash, trade it for reputation, or bury it to protect yourself.

⚖️ Build Your Reputation

In Neo Haven powerful organizations can be influenced with information or item sales. Support the City Security Division, work with Free Signal, the underground rebels, earn the trust of the independent Black Clinics, cooperate with SynTek, the city's leading corporation, or trade secrets with the information brokers.

Faction reputation influences customers, pawn item opportunities, and faction requests. Increase your reputation by selling the right items to the right faction or by completing requests through the faction request terminal (Black market).

🏪 Your Store. Your Style.

The people you choose to trust can shape your business and the kind of item stock you focus on. Build a more conventional equipment and grocery store, lean into underground contraband, or specialize through the factions you support. Your deals, stocked items, and faction requests all contribute to that direction.

🛡️ City Security Division
Legal equipment and trusted customers.

🩺 Black Clinics
Cyberware and advanced medical technology.

🖥️ SynTek
Electronics, industrial goods, and other high-value equipment.

📡 Information Brokers
Rare technology and encrypted devices.

⚡ Free Signal
Military surplus, weapons, and underground equipment.

Supporting different factions can change the kinds of items and opportunities you encounter. Your choices visibly transform the street right outside your door, including selected NPCs, world objects, and weather.

Features

    - inspect unusual items, negotiate deals, and decide which risks are worth taking. Run a clean shop or shift your business towards an underground hub.

Death has brought you to the Underworld. To avoid fading into oblivion, you must fight to survive.

Hunt, farm, fight, build, and trade as you slowly carve out a place for yourself in Netherworld Village. Seek a way to reincarnate—or stay behind and build a life of your own.

Ancient courts of the dead coexist with the everyday bustle of ordinary life, while all kinds of wandering souls continue their own strange version of “living.”

Survive in an Ever-Evolving World

Plants grow, animals reproduce, day turns to night, and the world continues to change around you. NPCs have their own jobs, routines, and behavioral patterns.

Hunt, gather, farm, and craft. Make the most of limited resources and find a way to survive.

Build a Business and Grow Your Influence

Meet all kinds of characters, recruit companions, trade goods, purchase property, produce resources, construct buildings, and run businesses as you build your own faction and reputation.

Become one of the wealthiest figures in the Underworld—or challenge the old order and rise as the new King of Hell.

Welcome to Giusto.

Giusto (Joo-stoh) is a single-player, bidding, trick-taking card game where you'll need to be PERFECT in order to maximize your STASH.  What originated in a college dorm room decades ago and has been passed down through generations, is now a solo indie dev's first game in the industry as he decided share it with the world. 

Play at a five-seat table against four other bot opponents, and choose how long each round runs based on your mood and time constraints. Play a quick 3-round match, an easy 5, or the full 10 rounds for max stash.  Each round, every player is dealt a hand - one card fewer than the round before - and a "Clobber suit" is turned face-up in the middle.  Then comes the heart of the game, where you and every other player will secretly lock in a bid of how many "sets" (tricks) they believe they'll win that round.  Right before each round begins, everyone's bids are revealed, telling you if the table in general is fighting for sets, dumping them, or it's a balanced table.  Highest card of whatever suit leads the round, wins the round. But, a clobber beats everything (except a higher clobber card), and at the end you compare what you said you'd do vs. what you actually did.

Miss your bid in either direction and you WHIFF, and that's where you get punished.  Giusto rewards perfection. Overbidding and underbidding hurts exactly the same.  You NEED to be perfect.  Your penalty is the gap between your bid and reality, multiplied by the round number. So, the later rounds bite the hardest,  Lowest cumulative score wins. This isn't a game about winning tricks.  It's a game about knowing yourself, and the table - predicting your own hand with precision, while having the restraint not to reach for more than you can handle.

The Countdown Button.

When you earn a reward, Giusto doesn't just hand it over - it gives you a chance to make it huge.  A timer appears after 2 or 3 perfect bids in a row depending on the game you're in.  You click to start it and it ticks towards 10, at a different pace every time, and only showing you the first few numbers - then you're on your own!  Click again the instant you believe it's hit true 10.000 - there's no rounding and no mercy: the game reads your real elapsed time and shows it to 3 decimal places. The closer you land to 10, the rarer the reward you earn. Land dead on 10.000 and there's only one word for it - everybody yells "GIUSTO!!" 

Beat the Game.

Most games don't let you beat them anymore - Giusto says, "bring it on".  Everything you play feeds one lifetime number.  Here's what you need to know:

  • Stash is your lifetime total that you'll use to compare against the global leaderboard and climb tiers to beat the game.  10,000 wins.

  • Gems are earned when you hit a bid exactly - a perfectly bid round, either twice or three times in a row (depending on how long of a game you're playing).  And, each one can reduce your in-game total, bringing you closer to victory (lowest score wins)

  • Matcha is won by winning a full match outright, and it's your chance to multiply your Stash - 2x up to 20x!! But, you'd better not be too far away because a bad miss earns a punishment from your Stash, too.

As your Stash grows, you climb a six-tier prestige ladder, and the armored woodland creature that sits at the center of your table transforms with you: from The Fawn (nervous, wide-eyed, just beginning) to The Firefly, The Phoenix, The Owl, The Mushroom, and finally - cross the 10,000 lifetime ranked Stash and earn The Machine Elf.  Your win is rewarded by the elusive Machine Elf, an inter-dimensional being that traverses space, time, and worlds in order to help  the Fawn get back to its' family.

Cross that line and you're permanently immortalized in the public Forest of Fame. From there, it's your call: Bloom - reset your Stash to zero and climb all over again with 1 bloom recorded on your Forest of Fame name, or keep playing as the Machine Elf, a new unlocked character that stays uncapped for as long as the forest holds your desire to compete for the top spot in the Forest of Fame

Made to Feel Just Right.

This game is meant to be an enchanted night of healthy competition, not a battlefield. But, the competition is real, and it's not to be ignored.  Just enjoy it at your own pace. There's no clock on any moves.  Take your time, or grind through to the top. It ships fully complete: no early access, no cut corners, no waiting for the "real" version.  Any monetization will be cosmetic-based only, and will never touch the playability of the game you're playing.  That's the promise. 

Sit down, breathe, and pick your moment...perfectly.  It's Giusto.

Glaring Flaw is a story-driven puzzle adventure built around the idea that every mystery has more than one perspective.
Explore a secluded rural family estate where each room is observed through fixed camera angles, and progression depends on unlocking new viewpoints. Hidden doors, overlooked objects, and subtle environmental clues only emerge when seen from the right perspective.

As the threat of an impending natural disaster forces Dino's family toward an uncertain future, the estate becomes a place suspended between tradition and change. What first appears familiar slowly reveals deeper layers of history, memory, and unresolved tension.

Features:

  • Perspective-Based Puzzle Solving – Progress through the story by unlocking four camera perspective tiers. Each new perspective changes how rooms can be explored, allowing you to uncover secrets, solve environmental puzzles, and reveal paths hidden in plain sight.

  • Layered Environmental Storytelling – Piece together the history of a fading family property through architecture, records, personal belongings, and remnants of the past.

  • A Handcrafted Rural Setting – Explore sprawling estate grounds, a wine cellar, repurposed guest houses now used as sheep shelters, and lived-in interiors filled with detail.

  • A Narrative of Departure and Transition – Experience the final days before leaving home as family members confront an approaching new era in different ways

Every newly unlocked perspective brings the player closer not only to the next puzzle, but to a broader understanding of the world Dino is about to leave behind.

A battle pet that lives on your desktop — and has a house.

Glims don't live inside a window. They walk your taskbar, climb the edges of your programs, sit down, doze off and chat with each other while you work. When you call, the game happens on your screen — not in a fullscreen window on top of it. It never steals focus, never covers what you're doing, and disappears with one click.

THE HOUSE

A small, transparent isometric 3D house in the corner of your screen. Eleven rooms to buy with in-game gold: they rest in the living room, sleep in the bedroom and cook in the kitchen; in the office, workshop, training area, storeroom, game room, lab, dungeon and arena they work, earn gold and get tired. Every room has its own catalogue — over three hundred pieces in all. Each piece of furniture is one unit: for two beds, buy two. Place a piece and a glim walks over to build it, hammer in hand, and it stays blue until it's done. The HOUSE button shows every room live, in a hive view, with how much each one earns per minute.

FOUR MODES, ALL ON YOUR SCREEN

  • Jade Castle — the twenty-floor dungeon. Build a squad of up to three and go down floor by floor; the fight runs itself, enemies have special moves, and every five floors there's a boss. After it, the only question that matters: leave with the loot, or go one deeper? Whoever falls stays down, and anything not banked is lost.
  • Invasion — a jade lawn assembles over your desktop and invaders come in from the right, lane by lane. Plant your glims to hold them: sword up close, bow and magic at range. Cards drop on the lawn and fly to your hand with a click.
  • Challenge — a boss at the top of the screen pours magic down and you dodge by dragging your glim with the mouse; it shoots on its own. Six bosses in rotation, four fury phases, bonuses falling from above and a rank from S to D. Grazing spells without getting hit scores points.
  • Arena — a 3v3 squad duel with gold on the line, paid out in glimbucks: the currency of the coloured chests.

Play three modes in one day to close the daily mission.

TEN GLIMS TO COLLECT

Each with its own card, stats and way of fighting. Weapons are real 3D models, fitted to the hand — or stowed on the back, for those who fight with claw and magic. Special weapons are numbered: every piece carries its own serial, unique in the world. Swap one in your inventory and see the difference on screen right away.

SEASONS AND PRESTIGE

Every eight weeks a season begins: gold earned, kills, floors and wins turn into points, and reaching a hundred earns the season title. Accumulated prestige raises what your house earns.

BUILT FOR EVERYONE TO PLAY

Remappable keys, a colourblind mode with three types and adjustable strength, interface size from 80% to 160%, and soft effects for anyone bothered by screen shake and flashes. You can play with the mouse alone.

FREE, LIGHT AND OFFLINE

The game is free and runs without a connection. It's light, stays open all day and doesn't get in the way of what you're doing. Purchases are optional and fixed: packs with the contents listed — nothing random costs money. Chests, furniture and rooms are bought with gold earned by playing.

Glitch Hunter: L-Virus Outbreak is a roguelike deckbuilder set inside a corrupted simulation.
The mysterious L-Virus has infected the game world, breaking its data and turning everything into distorted low-poly fragments. Monsters, environments, and even the rules of reality have been rewritten.

You are a hunter diving into a collapsing system.
Hunt virus-corrupted beasts, collect new cards, upgrade your build, and fight your way deeper into the core of the infection.

Combat is all about timing and tempo:
Guard at the right moment to reduce damage, maintain weapon momentum, and unleash explosive combos when the enemy is vulnerable.

Every run offers new routes, rewards, and deck possibilities.
Adapt your strategy, craft powerful synergies, and free the world from digital decay.

🎴 Roguelike Deckbuilding

Collect and upgrade cards to create unique builds.
Every run features different routes, encounters, and rewards.

🛡️ Guard-Based Tactical Combat

Defense is not passive—it’s the engine of your strategy.
Perfect guards create openings and set up devastating counterattacks.

⚔️ Combo Bursts and Finishers

Stack buffs, sharpen your weapon flow, and unleash game-changing burst turns.

👾 Virus Monsters in a Broken Low-Poly World

Explore corrupted forests, deserts, snowfields, and volcanic zones.
Defeat virus bosses and restore the simulation layer by layer.

Can you hunt down the L-Virus and restore the world before it collapses completely?

🍕 Build Delicious Factories

Cook your way around the world, one cat café at a time. Connect machines with conveyor belts and watch recipes come together. Plan at your own pace: nothing scores or spoils.

🐾 A Café Full of Opinions

Open for a timed service day and a hungry rush. Cats comment on meals, waits and furniture. Fresh plates and fast service earn more coins, which decide your rating. Chase three stars: every cat served, every plate fresh, nobody kept waiting.

🥬 Keep It Fresh

Early kitchens let you settle in without spoilage. From Sushi onward, food ages during service from the moment it is made, on belts, in machines and on the counter. Stale dishes dull, smoke and draw flies. A disappointed cat even names the ingredient that went stale, helping you rethink the line.

🌍 Travel the World

Ten handcrafted kitchens will take you from Pasta in Italy to Chicken Tikka Masala in India. Explore a hand-drawn travel-journal map and collect regional passport stamps.

📖 Discover, Tinker, Improve

Experiment to uncover your Discovery Journal's recipe tree. Spend coins on cozy furnishings, decorations and speed upgrades that work in every kitchen. Shape clever routes with fast belts, splitters, joiners and a Filter Arm, plus cookers with two independent slots.

💛 Pull Up a Cushion

A cozy cooking-automation game about tasty efficiency, made by a solo developer. Play in 10 languages. Try the free demo and wishlist the full game.

GLOOMDELVE

"Floor three. You died on floor three. I had money on floor five, so we're both disappointed."
- the Mad Wizard

A wizard has opened his dungeon to the public. A hundred floors, no map, and something at the bottom he will only ever refer to as the Prize. He watches the whole descent personally and does not shut up about it.

GloomDelve is a real-time roguelite dungeon crawler with no art assets. Not one modelled mesh, not one painted texture. Every wall, hero, horror and sword is drawn by code while you play. It looks like nothing else, and it runs on a toaster.

Bring someone

Go down alone, or don't. Online co-op is server-authoritative and comes with proximity voice chat, so you can hear exactly how badly your friend is doing from two rooms away. Plug in a second controller instead and you get true local split-screen: two delvers, one couch, one dungeon. Keyboard, gamepad and touch are all first-class, and every action works on all three.

The descent

  • 100 floors, generated fresh each run: rooms, traps, locked things, shops, and a few rooms that don't want to be found.
  • Themed depths. The dungeon changes its mind about what it is as you go, and the things living in it get meaner and cleverer.
  • Boss floors seal the stairs. Shove open the Great Door, find out what's behind it, and hope you brought the right build. Each one guards relics you cannot get anywhere else.
  • Seed-deterministic worlds. Find a run you like, hand the seed to a friend, get the same dungeon.
  • The Daily Delve. One shared dungeon a day: the same hundred floors for everyone, at a difficulty the wizard picks. Deepest floor is your score.

Break the game on purpose

The wizard deals you power cards: on entry, at the caches he leaves lying about, and after every boss. There's no cap on how many you carry. There are 95 in all, and he holds nearly half back until you've earned them. Most are useful on their own. A few of them, stacked in the right order, stop being fair. Finding those is the whole hobby.

Your delver

  • 9 classes with real restrictions: Warrior, Sorcerer, Rogue, Ranger, Cleric, Battlemage, Necromancer, and the hybrid Paladin and Spellblade. Each has a signature ability. Some have to be earned.
  • 8 races: Human, Halfling, Dwarf, Elf, Orc, Ratkin, the feline Mogg and the frost-hound Yukin, each with its own build, colours and stat leanings.
  • Combat you have to aim. Weapon arcs that differ per weapon, drawn bows, cast spells with real cooldowns, dual-wielding, shields worth raising, and blades that bleed, poison and burn.
  • Loot with opinions. Rolled rarities, shops, chests, forges, fountains you probably shouldn't drink from.

There's a story, if you want it

Nobody is going to explain the Prize to you. The dungeon will, slowly, in pages other people left behind. Recover them and they stay unlocked on your account, and they hand back more than just reading material. There are survivors down there too, still stuck, still asking for favours.

Pick your poison

Five difficulties - Whimsey, Mischief, Malice, Wrath and Madness - scale the bestiary, the loot, and how funny the wizard finds you.

Features

  • No art assets. Every mesh, texture and icon is generated by code
  • Solo, online co-op with positional voice chat, and local split-screen couch co-op
  • Roguelite power-card drafting: 95 cards, no hand limit
  • A Daily Delve: one seeded dungeon a day, the same for everyone
  • 9 classes, 8 races, 5 difficulties
  • A story hidden in the dungeon, and NPCs with their own problems
  • Hand-authored dynamic soundtrack, metal for the bosses
  • Full controller support, keyboard, and touch
  • Interface in 8 languages: English, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Português, Русский, 简体中文
  • Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud saves

The Prize is down there. The wizard is bored. Off you go.

Glow up Hero is a multi-hero deckbuilding roguelike.

Build a shared deck, play Ultimate cards, complete Beautify missions — and watch history’s legends transform.

Up to 4 Heroes on the Field

One shared deck for the whole party. Assign a caster when you play a card, weave in basic attacks freely — you’re commanding a squad, not a lone climber.

Beautify Is the Run-Long Payoff

Finish a hero’s Beautify mission to swap their look, power up their cards, clear debuffs, and fully heal.<br>

Beautify lasts for the rest of the run — you’re building a deck and a glamorous frontline.

Hero Workshop: An Ever-Growing Roster

Create your own heroes right in the game. Set their stats and abilities, design signature cards, and give them distinct looks before and after their glow-up. The tools are easy to use, and you can publish your creations directly to the Steam Workshop from within the game.

Classic Roguelike Route

Fights, events, shops, elites, bosses. Gear up with equipment, heirlooms, and blessings. Die and restart — every party combo plays differently.

Combat Rhythm

3 energy per turn; draw scales with how many heroes you have.

Heroes From History & Myth

Sun Wukong, Xiang Yu, Guan Yu, Thor, Diaochan, Athena, Zhuge Liang… 24 heroes, each with a clear cultural signature.

Party synergy sets the pace; after Beautify, even a familiar face feels brand new.

Features

  • Fast-paced arena gameplay

  • Resource gathering and progression

  • Unlockable characters

  • Upgradeable abilities and skills

  • Intelligent AI opponents

  • Dangerous creatures and environmental hazards

  • Global leaderboards

  • Endless replayability

  • Easy to learn, challenging to master

Can you become the ultimate GlowPits champion?

Goalcrest: Club Management Tycoon puts you in charge of a small football club at the very beginning of its journey. Your goal is to guide the team from the amateur leagues to the top of the football world, making every important decision both on and off the pitch.

Choose your formation, adjust your tactical style, select the best starting lineup, and prepare your squad for every match. Keep an eye on player fitness and team morale, react to upcoming opponents, and find the right balance between defensive stability and attacking football. Every result can influence your position in the league and the future of your club.

Managing a football club is not only about match results. You must also control the club’s finances, manage weekly expenses, negotiate sponsorship deals, and make sure the team remains financially stable. Spend your money carefully, improve your income, and avoid decisions that could put the club’s future at risk.

Develop your stadium and facilities to attract more supporters and create better conditions for your players. Adjust ticket prices, improve the stadium atmosphere, expand its capacity, and invest in the long-term growth of the club. Every upgrade brings you one step closer to building a professional football organization.

Follow transfer rumours, search for new talent, strengthen weak positions, and build a squad capable of competing for promotion. Monitor the league table, prepare for matchday, and make the decisions that can turn an unknown amateur team into a respected football powerhouse.

Your journey starts with limited resources, a modest stadium, and a team that still has everything to prove. Build your club step by step, overcome financial and sporting challenges, climb through the divisions, and create a legacy that supporters will remember.

She slew the Demon King.

Then everything she believed began to fall apart.

For generations, humanity has fought an endless war against the demons.

You begin as a young girl destined to become a knight.

Train through changing seasons.

Receive your knighthood.

Fight across ruined frontiers.

Rise to become the legendary Knight of the Sky.

Your final mission is simple:

Slay the Demon King.

Yet the moment your blade reaches its destination, something impossible happens.

Instead of finding the end of the war...

you awaken inside the memories of the very person you were meant to destroy.

The truth begins there.

A Playable Animated Film

Forbidden Codex tells its story without interrupting the player.

There are no dialogue boxes.

No quest markers.

No lengthy exposition.

Instead, the story unfolds naturally through:

Cinematic direction

Character animation

Environmental storytelling

Music and silence

Boss encounters

Exploration

Every scene is designed to feel like playing through a dark animated film rather than reading a traditional RPG.

Heavy, Deliberate Combat

Every sword swing carries weight.

Every clash creates impact.

Every boss encounter is built as both a battle and a dramatic scene.

Combat focuses on:

Deliberate close-range sword fighting

Heavy hit-stop and impactful feedback

Restrained visual effects

Boss encounters with emotional progression

Combat woven directly into the narrative

Rather than overwhelming the player with speed, Forbidden Codex emphasizes tension, timing, and consequence.

A World Falling Into Ruin

Journey through a dark fantasy world shaped by centuries of war.

Explore forgotten churches.

Rain-soaked cities.

Collapsed fortresses.

Ancient battlefields.

And the fading memories hidden beneath them.

Every environment exists to tell part of the world's history.

Two Girls.

One Endless War.

Experience the same tragedy from two different perspectives.

As the truth slowly unfolds, the line between hero and enemy begins to disappear.

Core Features

Cinematic pixel-art presentation

Heavy, weight-driven melee combat

Dual-perspective narrative

Environmental storytelling

Boss battles integrated into the story

Minimalist UI for maximum immersion

Orchestral soundtrack

Dark fantasy atmosphere

Sometimes the enemy remembers a different story.
